notes.title: Game update
notes.notes:
1. Added bankruptcy and subsistence protection function. If you have less than 50 in the game and there is not enough gold coins for treatment and food purchase, you can enter the official hall and click to apply for subsistence allowance, you can get free and get free of charge. treatment
2. Add a Hell Merchant NPC. After entering the Nether, you will see a 骷髅, click to enter the store, you can use the monster heart to buy some powerful monsters to fight for you, you can only buy one and only one battle at a time. It is recommended to use when playing Raiders legend monsters.
3. Add the auction function of special items, and freely trade special items in the auction, such as washing medicine, etc.
4. Add the drop of legendary equipment, get it by killing the legendary monster, and the legendary weapon has a larger damage bonus.

notes.title: Map Update
notes.notes:
This edition has made great adjustments to the maps of Nordic and Western Regions, from the overall appearance of the map, to the display of monsters, and then to the size of the map, which comprehensively solved the previous slots. Comments are welcome.

The next version will make some of the tools in the bazaar work, such as shovels, shovels on the ground, stones, shovels and so on. There are opportunities to shovel food, medicines and other things, more likely to shovel rare items, or even dig a hole. For example, eating beef with tableware on your body will increase the satiety, drinking beer with a Western wine glass will increase the satiety, more than 40 interesting functions have been opened one after another.
